model: ECS and SmartPlate water heaters (ProtoNode RER)
equipment_type: Water heater controller via ProtoNode gateway
applies_to: AERCO SmartPlate and ECS (Electric Valve) water heaters, up to four, read through the AERCO ProtoNode RER.
summary: The AERCO ProtoNode RER profile for four ECS/SmartPlate systems serves 7 analog values per heater on BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP: control output, setpoint in use, a writable remote setpoint, outlet and feedback temperatures, an alarm bit field and flow rate.
default_device_instance: Node_Offset + A-bank DIP switch value (MAC); the manual's example uses Node_Offset 50,000
notes: Older document (OMM-0080_0H, November 2014) for the ProtoNode RER gateway.
Object IDs are fixed per profile and do not follow a formula; heaters 1-4 are ECS/SmartPlate Modbus addresses 29-32.
Point names repeat for each heater; the heater number is in the description.

integration.summary: Set S2 On (S0, S1, S3, A1 Off) for the BACnet profile with 4 ECS/SP systems, give the heaters addresses 29-32, and for remote setpoint set Rmt = SP and L-r = rmt on each heater. Then write 03-RmSetpt and read outlet temperature, control output and the alarm bit field.
integration.enable: For remote setpoint control set Rmt = SP and L-r = rmt on the heater, then write its 03-RmSetpt. There is no start/stop object.
setup: S2 On, S0/S1/S3 Off, A1 Off = BACnet IP / MS/TP profile with 4 ECS/SP systems.
Device instance = Node_Offset (set in the Web Configurator) + A-bank DIP value; MS/TP MAC is 1-127 on A0-A7, baud on B0-B3.
Default IP 192.168.1.24; change it in the ProtoNode web GUI.
Modbus side: every AERCO unit at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity.
gotchas: Heater object IDs are scattered (heater 1 setpoint is AV 80-81, heater 2 is AV 3-4); use the table, not a pattern.

source.title: AERCO ProtoNode Gateway User Manual (ProtoNode-RER / ProtoNode-LER), GF-129
